title: Check the live server against the public repo
what: When the server starts, it now hashes every file it runs and serves and publishes the list with the commit it was deployed from. The Proof page shows the commit and one tree hash. Check out that commit and the same hash comes out of one shell command, or run check-build.mjs to see any file that differs. Deploys only go out from code that is committed and pushed.

title: Web search, off by default
what: Press Web next to the message box and that one message searches the web first. The answer lists the pages it used under Sources, and the switch turns itself off after sending. The search runs at Exa through OpenRouter for $0.007, which sits inside the same receipt you can check against OpenRouter. Zero data retention covers the model, not the search, and the screen says so: Exa keeps its own logs of the query. Not on free messages or Confidential models. API: add "web_search": true.

title: Confidential models, with their attestation
what: Three models now come in a Confidential version: GLM 5.3 Flash, Qwen3.8 27B and DeepSeek V4.1 Flash. They run at NEAR AI inside hardware enclaves (Intel TDX and NVIDIA confidential computing), and the request is locked to that provider with no fallback. Each one links to NEAR AI's public attestation report, which we re-fetch every 30 minutes, and the tag disappears if the report stops coming back. The receipt under each answer still checks against OpenRouter's record, which names the provider.

title: Chat with your PDFs, privately
what: Attach a PDF in the chat and ask about it. Your browser reads the text out of the file, so the file is never uploaded and no OCR service sees it. Only the text goes out, inside your message, and "What we sent" marks it. Before you send, the app shows the page count, the token estimate and what it will cost on the model you picked. Send with no question and you get a summary.

title: Monthly fee report you can re-check
what: Every $GHOST creator fee claimed this month in one page: the ETH claimed, the 25% sent to the treasury for holders, the 75% sent to the team, and the gas kept for transfers. Then how the holder share became Ghost Credit, hour by hour. Nine checks run before the page shows, and one command re-runs them all, including every transfer and GhostLedger root on Robinhood Chain.

title: Personas saved in your browser
what: Save a model with your own instructions and start a chat with it in one tap. Personas are saved in this browser only, not in our database. The instructions go out as the first message of each request, passing through our server like your prompt without being kept, and "What we sent" marks them so you see exactly what the model receives. Download one as a file to use it on another device.

title: Spend limits and expiry on API keys
what: Give any API key a name, a daily USD limit and an expiry date. A key at its limit stops until 00:00 UTC, and an expired key stops for good, so you can hand one to an agent or a script without risking your whole balance. Parallel calls are counted too.

title: A receipt for every answer
what: Every answer now carries OpenRouter's generation ID, the exact cost and a SHA-256 of what was forwarded. Press "Check against OpenRouter" under any answer to see OpenRouter's own record next to what we billed. Your account page exports every call as CSV.

title: Researched roadmap
what: The roadmap now lists what shipped before the token, what shipped on launch day, and seven Next items picked from what people ask private AI tools for.

title: On-chain alerts and payout posts in the group
what: Every buy on the Pons curve and every hourly Ghost Credit payout is posted to the Telegram group straight from chain events, with the transaction linked.

title: DEX Screener chart on the site
what: Price and volume from DEX Screener on the front page and the $GHOST page, with a note on where the curve price lives until graduation.

title: Live creator-fee meter
what: What is waiting in the Pons curve and escrow, and what has been split 25% to holders and 75% to the team, read from the chain every minute.

title: Holder perks
what: Wallets holding 100,000+ $GHOST get 30 free messages a day, 30 free API calls a day and 600 API requests a minute.

title: First Ghost Credit payout
what: $27.06 of AI credit to 74 wallets for 15:00-16:00 UTC, with the hour's Merkle root posted to GhostLedger. It now runs every hour there are fees.
